preprocessing.spatial_description: crop to the bounding box of nonzero voxels, then resize that box to 128^3. Does NOT use the label: the box comes from image intensity only, so localization is not oracle.
preprocessing.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score before resize; unchanged by the crop because the crop removes only zero voxels
preprocessing.must_match_training: the test cache must be built by the same builder with the same flags; any deviation invalidates the readout

protocol.target: WT = raw labels {1,2,3}; RC label 4 excluded
protocol.clicks: 3 accumulated corrective clicks; click1 uniform GT foreground, click2/3 uniform XOR error, FN positive, FP negative
protocol.postprocessing: none; no threshold, TTA, morphology or connected-component search

code_binding.fail_closed: if any hash here does not match at test time, abort; do not rewrite the hash

comparison_target.note: The reference arm is the whole-head-resize full-unfreeze arm on the SAME 270 cases. This arm differs from it in exactly one factor (spatial preprocessing), so the test delta IS a controlled contrast -- unlike the reference arm's own delta against the earlier LoRA/rank-0 arms, which was explicitly marked non-attributable.

evidence_boundary: Training and epoch selection used NO test data. This freeze is written before any test NIfTI is opened.
This will be the 6th consumption of these 270 cases by the project. It is an internal held-out readout, not clean external validation.
The result must NOT be used to select a next arm, tune hyperparameters, or choose between models.
No threshold, TTA, morphology, connected-component or postprocessing search was or will be run.
